about: Scrolls a region with the theme's thin bars in place of the browser's scrollbars. While its content overflows, the viewport is a named region in the tab order, and the arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End scroll it. A bar shows only while its own axis overflows. Press the bar to jump, drag the thumb, or turn the wheel over it.

fade.about: `fade` fades an edge towards the content scrolled out of view, over the distance left to scroll up to 2rem. An edge the content ends at does not fade.
fade.title: Fading edges

inset.about: `inset` pads the content from the inset scale, from 8px at `xs` to 20px at `lg`. The viewport clips its content, so a child's focus ring needs `xs` to show whole.
inset.title: Insets

maxHeight.about: `maxHeight` stops the viewport's height at a named size, from `xs` at 20rem to `lg` at 32rem. Content shorter than the size keeps its own height.
maxHeight.title: Heights

notes.about: A card's release notes scroll under its title, up to the `xs` height, in line with the title. The area scrolls vertically, the default `scrolls`, so the notes wrap at the viewport's width. Tab onto the notes and use the arrow keys, or hover them to show the bar.
notes.heading: Release notes

r35.summary: Exports run in the background and email a link when the file is ready.

r36.summary: Invoices take a purchase order number, printed under the address.

r37.summary: Payouts show the fee of each transfer beside its amount.

r38.summary: Reports group their rows by customer, by month or by both.

r39.summary: Two-step sign-in accepts a security key as well as a code.

r40.summary: The ledger opens at the last period you closed.

r41.summary: Search finds an invoice by any line of its address.

r42.summary: Refunds of more than one payment settle in a single transfer.

notes.title: Release notes

palette.about: The theme's eight palettes, one row of ten roles each, scroll both ways with `scrolls="both"` inside a room 24rem wide, up to the `xs` height. The corner keeps the two bars apart.
palette.label: Theme palettes
palette.title: Both directions

rtl.about: Under `dir="rtl"` the vertical bar is at the left, and the content and the horizontal thumb start at the right.
rtl.title: Right to left

size.about: `size` sets the thumbs' thickness, from 4px at `xs` to 12px at `lg`. The scenes set `variant="always"`, so the bars show at rest.
size.title: Bar thickness

title: Scroll area

topics.about: A row of topic filters scrolls sideways with fading edges. `scrolls="horizontal"` lets the row widen the content, so the content's padding follows the last filter. The arrow keys move between the filters, and the area scrolls each focused filter into view.
topics.label: Topics
topics.title: Horizontal

variant.about: `hover` shows the bars under the pointer, while the area scrolls and while focus is inside it, over the content's edge. `always` shows them at rest and keeps the content clear of them.
variant.title: Visibility
